Description.Name: MercNews Broadcast
Description.Details:
[[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[LoreGM],General Motors]] and Johnston Industries have contracted mercenary forces to stabilize the [[DM.SystemDefs[starsystemdef_Acamar],Acamar]] region and ensure uninterrupted trade operations.  [[DM.Factions[faction_Cameron],The Terran Hegemony]], currently engaged elsewhere, has authorized the operation.


Should you accept you will be deployed as part the initial landing force, securing the area until the main force can be committed.

Description.Name: Let's go.  <color=#99ebff>(Begin the Operation STILETTO campaign)</color>
Insertion
Description.Details:
Initial intelligence gathered by [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreTaskForceAcamar],Task Force Acamar]] --- led by GM security director [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreAntonCorrigan],Anton Corrigan]] --- has identified the optimal landing site and forward base location for the region.



The task force wears the Terran Hegemony's colors as a mark of legitimacy.

Description.Name: No thank you.  (Pass on the campaign)
MercNews Broadcast
Description.Details: Breaking News: Task Force Acamar Declares System Secure After Pirate Campaign After months of pirate activity at mining sites and a major raid on Huss, [[DM.BaseDescriptionDefs[kosLoreTaskForceAcamar],Task Force Acamar]], backed by GM, Johnston Industries, and [[DM.Factions[faction_Cameron],House Cameron]], pursued and assaulted the pirate base in the Sorrow Mountains. Most pirates were neutralized, with only a few escaping.
